notes: Baseline is the previous best native Rust deferred configuration, frozen before the goal implementation.
Requests were sequential, with alternating order and four workers each.
goal-screen precedes extra profiling fields; its executable hash was not retained.
goal-http and same-binary use the first build; cold-http and profile use the isolated helper build; factor-http adds the same-arithmetic adjacent CDF lookup optimization.
CPU covers all child threads and includes server startup/health/shutdown; HTTP process_ms is complete client request wall time.
Final aggregate HTTP increase is +0.239%; a strict latency non-increase is not established; remains opt-in.
